title: Three Equal Parts
description: Partition an array into three parts with equal binary values.
pseudocode:
1. count = sum(arr)
2. if count % 3 != 0 return [-1, -1]
3. if count == 0 return [0, 2]
4. target = count / 3
5. find indices of each part's start
6. compare trailing zeros and values
7. if match return [i, j+1]

steps.note: Calculate total number of 1s in the array [1,0,1,0,1].
Total 1s is 3, so each part must contain exactly 1 one.
Identify start indices of segments containing 1s: 0, 2, 4.
Verify segments: [1,0], [1,0], [1] followed by matching trailing zeros.
